subject: PO identifier and bank verification for Solvaris vendor registration
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@solvaris.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@solvaris.com, Gideon Lee <gideon.lee@solvaris.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO identifier and bank verification — action required

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Procurement has a couple of gating items before they can create Redwood as a vendor in Solvaris' AP system: a consistent PO identifier we can map to invoices, and a bank verification file for EFT setup.

Attached is a redacted sample PO from our system (Solvaris_PO_sample_12345.pdf). Two things to confirm on your side:
- Do you accept our 10-digit PO number as the primary invoice reference, or do you need an alternate vendor-supplied invoice ID?
- Our finance team also requests a bank routing confirmation (.txt or bank-mandated file) to complete the EFT enrollment. Can Redwood provide a signed routing confirmation or will you accept a notarized bank letter?

Lastly, our AP requires a PO checksum/hash to be present in the invoice metadata field "PO_HASH" (algorithm: SHA256) so our portal can automatically reconcile. Do you generate a stable checksum for POs when you send invoices, or should we accept a plain PO number plus a vendor-provided UUID?

We'd like to get vendor creation scheduled for next Tuesday (11/10). Let me know what you need from our side to make that happen.

Thanks,
Elena Moreno
Head of Procurement Operations
Solvaris Therapeutics
Attachment: Solvaris_PO_sample_12345.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@solvaris.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO identifier and bank verification — action required

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a proposed plan: 

1) PO identifier: We can map Solvaris' 10-digit PO number as the primary invoice reference. Redwood's billing pipeline will surface the PO_NUMBER field as invoice.metadata.po_number and include a vendor UUID (vendor_uuid) for internal tracking. For your automated reconciliation you can use PO_NUMBER; for any downstream support we'll correlate vendor_uuid.

2) PO checksum: Our billing generator can produce an SHA256 hash of the PO payload (PO_NUMBER + date + total_amount) and include it as invoice.metadata.PO_HASH. If you'd rather we compute over just the PO_NUMBER we can do that too — which option is preferred?

3) Bank verification / EFT: Redwood prefers a signed bank letter (bank letterhead + account last 4 + routing details). We can also accept a cleared micro-deposit verification flow if Solvaris' portal supports it. If you require a notarized file, let us know and we'll coordinate with finance.

Next steps (proposed):
- Solvaris provides the preferred PO_HASH algorithm scope (PO_NUMBER only OR PO_NUMBER + date + total).
- Elena, please send the bank routing format you require (sample fields) — we can return a signed bank letter and a system-extract (solvaris_bank_routing_confirmation.txt) for portal upload.
- Once we have those, Redwood finance (Rachel) will submit vendor credentials and Ben will confirm EFT enrollment timelines.

I'll copy our finance/ops leads. Targeting vendor creation on Tue 11/10 is fine.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
